name: opencode-commit-message
description: Generate Git commit messages with the opencode CLI instead of GitHub Copilot.

opencodeCommit.command.markdownDescription: Path to the `opencode` executable. Use an absolute path when VS Code cannot find it on `PATH` (common when VS Code is launched from a desktop launcher).

opencodeCommit.args.markdownDescription: Arguments placed before the model and agent flags. Use `["run"]` for opencode versions without `--archived`.

opencodeCommit.agent.markdownDescription: Agent passed with `--agent`. Leave empty to use the default agent. The repository ships `.opencode/agents/commit-msg.md`.

opencodeCommit.model.markdownDescription: Optional model passed with `--model`, for example `google/gemini-3.8-flash`. Leave empty to use the default model.

opencodeCommit.instructions.markdownDescription: Extra instructions appended to the prompt, for example a preferred language or a stricter subject length.

opencodeCommit.maxDiffChars.description: Maximum number of diff characters sent to the model. Larger diffs are truncated.

opencodeCommit.timeoutSeconds.description: Abort generation after this many seconds.
